name: CRF
note: the estimator shape (`fit(X, y)`, `predict`, `predict_marginals`, `score`) over lists of feature dictionaries: the parts are all there, but as functions on a model record, not an estimator on the learn base

name: sequence_accuracy_score
note: the share of sequences labelled entirely right is `sequenceError` on the training tape; no named metric

name: torchcrf.CRF
note: a CRF layer on top of a neural encoder: emission scores come from the network, transitions are parameters, the loss is the CRF negative log-likelihood and prediction is Viterbi; gradients flow into the encoder. The inference is in `pgm` on plain arrays; a differentiable version over tensors (so that a BiLSTM or transformer tagger can train end to end) does not exist.
